scope: Fabricated quadratic/support/worker cases only. No canonical observations, old results, truth, evaluator or model calls.

policy.start: PUBLIC_MEAN exactly; no fitted vector or alternate seed
policy.metric: full G + diag(KERNEL_PRECISION); no eigenvalue or covariance repair
policy.scaled_metric: B * outer(PUBLIC_SD,PUBLIC_SD), one symmetric outer-product scale
policy.arithmetic: fsum of computed products; explicit eta terms and upward directional/model/final guards. Stored/computed operands only, no real-model/libm/derivative certificate.
policy.counts: Every objective/gradient evaluation including one forced final verification; constant Hessian requests do not evaluate objective or prior.
policy.uncertainty: No posterior covariance, intervals, coverage or nonlinear stationarity inferred

public_prior.base_measure: Lebesgue dx in original entering x chart
public_prior.normalizer: Z_D common to both arms, omitted only from MAP/cost contrasts
